fields_consumed_by_original_loader.4: NUL-terminated narrow filename; original helper converts to a wide resource path

lmpd.identity: All 18732 payload IDs equal their chunk IDs and reference an existing item/model in the same ADF.
lmpd.trailing_bytes: Original 0x004a1930 does not consume post-name numeric fields. Post-NUL bytes include stale process values and uninitialized padding; do not interpret them as float atlas transforms. Exact unused field semantics are intentionally not claimed.
lmpd.duplicate_binding_rule: The loader binds each lmpd to its model as encountered; a later binding replaces the previous texture handle.
lmpd.atlas_transform: No lmpd atlas affine transform exists in the recovered loader/shader path. Stored triangle UV1 is used directly.

resource_path.no_zone_selected: lightmaps/<filename> when original zone identifier is0xffffffff
resource_path.prefix_evidence: UTF-16 literal at0x005983cc is lightmaps\; separator literal at0x005929cc is \.
resource_path.fallback: If initial filename does not load, remove its final three characters and append jpg (UTF-16 literal at0x005983c4). This is an original-resource fallback, not permission to generate replacements.
resource_path.case_resolution: Inspector uses case-insensitive archive member matching, consistent with original Windows resource paths.
resource_path.missing_resources: Report unresolved original references; do not invent a texture or atlas layout. Original shader selection tests resource availability.

per_model_binding.handle_assignment: 0x0045eeb0 releases previous reference, assigns selected texture resource, increments new resource+0x34 reference count.
per_model_binding.shader_selection: 0x00443c60 executes after assigning each group lightmap handle.
per_model_binding.critical_offset_distinction: drawGroup+0x18 is material+0x04. Binder0x00444190 material+0x18 is a DIFFERENT custom shader override and is not the lmpd lightmap handle.
per_model_binding.assembly_evidence: 0x0047e547 lea ebx,[group+0x18];0x0047e55b ecx=ebx;0x0047e55d call0x0045eeb0;0x0047e562 lea ecx,[group+0x14];0x0047e566 call0x00443c60.
per_model_binding.instance_specialization: All draw groups of the target model receive its lightmap; a replacement sharing mesh/material geometry across differently bound instances must specialize their binding, not mutate a global material index.
per_model_binding.sampler_selection: Original0x00444190 uses material[1] lightmap at sampler1 when no intermediate env/normal texture is bound, otherwise at sampler2.

uv1.source_pair: IEEE754 float32 u,v at each offset
uv1.vertex_shader: original/app/base/shaders/v_dif_lit_shd.vsh lines45,54,60: TEXCOORD1/ATTR8 consumed as v8; mov oT1.xy,v8.xyxx. No scale/offset transformation.

fragment_shader.instruction_evidence: lines31..36:tex t0;tex t1;mul t1.rgb,t1,c4.a;mul r0.a,v0.a,t0.a;add t0.rgb,t0,-t1;mul r0.rgb,v0,t0.
fragment_shader.important: This variant subtracts the supplied luminance/occlusion map. It does NOT multiply diffuse.rgb by lightmap.rgb.
fragment_shader.non_lightmapped_variant: t_dif_lit.psh lines26..27 samples diffuse and multiplies by vertex color without sampling lightmap.
fragment_shader.multiplier: Original shader constant c4.a comes from lighting_multipliers_1.a; its runtime value must be supplied by the renderer's recovered lighting contract, not invented here.
fragment_shader.scope: Other env/normal/fade shader variants retain their own original contracts; this evidence does not equate all shader variants.

static_corpus.match_count_note: Zone/root candidates are reported separately; some bindings match both. Root candidate is not a speculative fallback for an active-zone binding.
static_corpus.unresolved_note: Some original filenames contain a literal tab. Inspector does not silently sanitize or trim them.
